source_row.rationale: Keeping the hospital bed in the lowest position when the client is not receiving direct care (raising it only as needed for care activities) is a standard fall prevention practice intended to reduce the distance of a potential fall and therefore the severity of injury if the client falls or attempts to get out of bed independently.
source_row.source_detail: Purpose of Low Bed Positioning for Fall Prevention
